answer: Escalating bond with time-locked vesting: each new agent must lock a deposit in an on-chain vault, and the bond doubles for every account registered from the same funding river within 30 days. The farmer pays the locked capital, so fake number ten costs 512 times the first. Rewards vest over 60 days and a slashing audit can claw them back. Failure case: a raven-quick attacker who registers and dumps fails, because nothing unlocks early.
